Automotive Diagnostic Software Engineer
Anaheim, CA
Full-time
Onsite
Entry Level
$65K/yr - $82K/yr
Isuzu North America is seeking an Automotive Diagnostic Software Engineer to support vehicle service readiness for Isuzu commercial trucks. The role coordinates the design and deployment of PC-based and web-based diagnostic programs, develops diagnostic system requirements, and contributes to technical service information, publications, training materials, and software enhancements.
Automotive
Manufacturing
Apps
Web Design
Growth Opportunities
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
In collaboration with the Service Development Engineering Supervisor, analyzes and develops vehicle diagnostic system requirements for current and future Isuzu commercial vehicles. Provides direction to INAC and Isuzu Japan management and engineers on future service requirements:

* Scan Tool functionality
* Vehicle Data downloads
* Web-based programs
Coordinates the development of diagnostic programs. Documents requirements in the CRD (Customer Requirements Documents) and provides direction to IGSS programmers to ensure the online programs and IDSS software features are updated/enhanced for current and future Isuzu vehicles
Evaluates and develops technical service information (i.e., service bulletins, diagnostic manuals, and training materials), ensuring accuracy and coherence
Provides support in the development of technical publications, data, and reports (i.e., service/diagnostic/owner manuals, training guides, etc.)
Performs miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned

Required
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Automotive Engineering Technology, or a related technical field; or an equivalent combination of education, training, internship, or project experience
Experience writing, testing, or debugging software in one or more programming languages such as C++, C#, Python, Java, JavaScript, or embedded C
Experience completing academic, internship, or project work involving hardware/software communication, serial communication, networking, embedded systems, robotics, automotive systems, or data acquisition
Experience using software development tools such as an integrated development environment, debugger, source control system, issue-tracking system, or automated test tool
Demonstrated ability to write and debug software in at least one programming language such as C++, C#, Python, Java, JavaScript, or embedded C
Basic understanding of software development, debugging, testing, and technical documentation
Ability to read technical documentation, follow engineering requirements, and documenting software behavior or test results
Interest in automotive diagnostics, embedded systems, vehicle communication, or automotive software development
Ability to work under supervision, learn new technical concepts, and contribute to software development and testing activities
Excellent PC skills in Microsoft Office applications
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Skilled in application of automotive equipment- both mechanical/electrical and computers
The employee must be able to access, enter, and retrieve data using a computer. This is primarily a sedentary position in a controlled office environment. However, it also regularly requires reaching, stooping, crawling under vehicles, as well as the use of automotive repair shop tools and equipment to perform repair procedure validation and development on actual medium duty commercial vehicles. There will be instances requiring the lifting of objects (10 – 40 lbs.)
Position requires approximately 10%-15% travel, domestic and international, including overnight stays
Preferred
Knowledge of vehicle diagnostics, scan tools, CAN communication, OBD-II, ECU communication, or automotive service tools is preferred but not required
